watches.reason: The accepted corpus ships the July 2026 Ogor Mawtribes battletome battle formations, heroic traits, and artefacts provisionally from BSData, and cannot ship the two battletome lores at all until a source publishes them. Any of these appearing on the Wahapedia faction page satisfies the verification condition for the provisional facts and unblocks the lore transition.

The ten July 2026 Ogor Mawtribes supplement units ship provisionally from BSData because Wahapedia still lists only the pre-supplement warscrolls. Any of these appearing on the Wahapedia warscroll collection satisfies the verification condition for the provisional unit facts.

BSData's Lore of Gut Magic and Lore of the Everwinter entries are dangling links: the spell and prayer group definitions are not transcribed anywhere at the pinned commit, so the fallback tier cannot supply the battletome lores. The group definitions appearing in the moving main-branch faction catalogue would allow a fallback-tier intake of the lores while Wahapedia still lags.
